test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The ratio of the speed of a bus to that of a train is 15 ∶ 27. Also, a car covers a distance of 720 km in 9 hours. The speed of the bus is three-fourths of the speed of the car. How much distance will the train cover in 7 hours?
solution:
Given:

The ratio of the speed of a bus to that of a train is 15 ∶ 27. 

Also, a car covers a distance of 720 km in 9 hours. 

The speed of the bus is three-fourths of the speed of the car. 

Concept used:

Distance = Speed × Time

Calculation:

Speed of the car = 720/9 = 80 km/h

So, speed of the bus = 3/4 × 80 = 60 km/h

So, speed of the train = 27 × (60 ÷ 15) = 108 km/h

Now, the distance that the train will cover in 7 hours = 108 × 7 = 756 km

∴ The train will cover 756 km.
